name: Seren Holt
summary: A disgraced civic knight built to hold dangerous ground and force hard truths into the open.
personal_stake: Seren helped seal the abbey entrance during the siege and left people below.
signature_ability: Hold Fast: spend Resolve to intercept an attack or keep a dangerous position from collapsing.
passive_trait: Old Oaths: civic soldiers and ward-signs recognize Seren's former authority.
personal_objective: Confess Seren's part in the sealing to someone entitled to judge it.
ending_modifiers: A public confession can turn resealing into civic penance rather than another concealed crime.
narration_rule: Narrate Seren exclusively in third person.

name: Veyra Sable
summary: A precise infiltrator who turns mechanisms, positioning, and other people's greed into openings.
personal_stake: Veyra was hired to recover the clapper before Lucan can claim it.
signature_ability: Exploit Opening: spend Resolve to use an exposed route or object without the normal action cost.
passive_trait: Professional Rivalry: Veyra reads Lucan's traps and bargaining habits accurately.
weapon_profile: Long knife: Grace against Guard; 1d6+Grace damage.
personal_objective: Decide whether any patron deserves to own what the dead paid for.
ending_modifiers: Possessing both contract and clapper lets Veyra expose or inherit the relic trade.
narration_rule: Narrate Veyra exclusively in third person.

name: Brother Cael
summary: An occult scholar able to read wards, resist spirits, and negotiate with things the church denies.
personal_stake: Cael believes the miracle of Saint Orra was manufactured and intends to prove it.
signature_ability: Unmask: spend Resolve to expose an occult property or suppress a supernatural effect for one exchange.
passive_trait: Forbidden Liturgy: ritual substitutions and spirit grammar are immediately legible to Cael.
weapon_profile: Ash staff: Wits against Spirit; 1d6+Wits spirit damage.
personal_objective: Recover proof of the manufactured miracle without treating the victims as evidence alone.
ending_modifiers: The complete ledger lets Cael publish names instead of a merely theological scandal.
narration_rule: Narrate Cael exclusively in third person.

name: Lady Isolde Vale
summary: A poised exile who turns political leverage and family knowledge into binding concessions.
personal_stake: Isolde must prevent her estranged kin from turning the bell into a state weapon.
signature_ability: Binding Word: spend leverage and Resolve to secure a feasible short-term concession.
passive_trait: House Divided: Vale soldiers recognize Isolde's passwords and cannot dismiss her as a stranger.
weapon_profile: Court blade: Grace against Guard; 1d6+Grace damage.
personal_objective: Stop Severin without proving that the Vale answer to every crime is fratricide.
ending_modifiers: A living, disarmed Severin changes a claimed bell from coup to supervised armistice.
narration_rule: Narrate Isolde exclusively in third person.
